mapper.select: SELECT resource_id FROM user_resource_auth WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND resource_type = #{resourceType} AND status = 1 AND (expire_at IS NULL OR expire_at > NOW()) ORDER BY id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_resource_auth ( user_id, resource_type, resource_id, granted_by, status ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{resourceType}, #{resourceId}, #{grantedBy}, 1 ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE granted_by = VALUES(granted_by), status = 1, expire_at = NULL, updated_at = NOW()
